text:
Don't go. They already made an appointment for you, but when it was time, they didn't call you. I went to ask, and they said there were six appointments ahead of me. The doctor was in at 5:00 PM, so I thought they'd be available at what time?

They accept walk-ins. Go to another clinic. The difference isn't that big of a deal. Don't get frustrated with the clinic's poor time management. If it's not convenient, don't make an appointment. There are tons of dental clinics that accept social security, and there are far, far better ones. If you don't want to get upset, go somewhere else.

The clinic is small, hot, and crowded. There's no comfortable waiting area. There's no parking. You have to park on the side of the road, in front of shops, or in front of other people's houses.

Time is important. Your time and that of others is just as valuable.

No comments are allowed for treatment.

I've warned you, everyone.
